text:
We paid 30,000.
Not everyone has to pay a deposit.
It's only in cases where MH has "suspicions" that the relationship isn't "real".
If they do request it it is most likely before receiving the invitation or first visa, although I have some friends that were asked at a later stage.
When they request a deposit they will likely say when you get it back. For example when you move to the A5.
In our case they said they would keep the deposit until we finish the process. And it was requested to receive the first B1.
Good luck 🙏
